Enable multi-language detection and inspect every ISO 639-3 code that clears the confidence threshold.

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const xberg = @import("xberg");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try xberg.extract("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"mime_type\":\"text/markdown\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/markdown/comprehensive.md\"}", "{\"language_detection\":{\"detect_multiple\":true,\"enabled\":true,\"min_confidence\":0.3}}");
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
